checked_markdown_lines: Building Construction Illustrated (5th Edition): A space frame is a long-spanning three-dimensional plate structure based on triangular rigidity. Locator: Building Construction Illustrated refined markdown lines 1901-1905, 2063-2132, and 6655-6682

Building Construction Illustrated (5th Edition): Space-frame members are linear elements subject primarily to axial tension or compression. Locator: Building Construction Illustrated refined markdown lines 1901-1905, 2063-2132, and 6655-6682

Building Construction Illustrated (5th Edition): The simplest spatial unit is a tetrahedron with four joints and six members. Locator: Building Construction Illustrated refined markdown lines 1901-1905, 2063-2132, and 6655-6682

Building Construction Illustrated (5th Edition): A space-frame supporting bay should be square or nearly square so the system acts as a two-way structure. Locator: Building Construction Illustrated refined markdown lines 1901-1905, 2063-2132, and 6655-6682

Building Construction Illustrated (5th Edition): Folded plates, domes, suspension/cable-stayed structures, and pneumatic structures have distinct load-path cues. Locator: Building Construction Illustrated refined markdown lines 1901-1905, 2063-2132, and 6655-6682

Building Structures Illustrated (2nd Edition): Long-span structures are used for large column-free spaces such as arenas, theaters, hangars, terminals, and warehouses. Locator: Building Structures Illustrated refined markdown lines 4925-4961 and 4979-4980

Building Structures Illustrated (2nd Edition): For this source, spans over 60 ft (18 m) are treated as long span. Locator: Building Structures Illustrated refined markdown lines 4925-4961 and 4979-4980

Building Structures Illustrated (2nd Edition): Deflection, ponding, redundancy, thrust, and lateral stability are major long-span design issues. Locator: Building Structures Illustrated refined markdown lines 4925-4961 and 4979-4980

Building Structures Illustrated (2nd Edition): Two-way systems such as space frames and domes require nearly square or circular support patterns. Locator: Building Structures Illustrated refined markdown lines 4925-4961 and 4979-4980

Building Structures Illustrated (2nd Edition): Transport and field assembly constraints matter for long-span members. Locator: Building Structures Illustrated refined markdown lines 4925-4961 and 4979-4980
Hibbeler Statics 13th Edition: A space truss is a three-dimensional truss built from tetrahedral elements. Locator: Hibbeler Statics refined markdown line 26514
Hibbeler Statics 13th Edition: Space truss joints are assumed as ball-and-socket connections in the checked statics source. Locator: Hibbeler Statics refined markdown line 26514
